main.description: Publish an AGGREGATE-FIRST supply-chain intel report derived by kabuto/methods/analyze.py. The report ranks supply concentration (single-source suppliers, sector/jurisdiction concentration) routed to redundancy + accountability — NEVER a target-list (kabuto G2). Every report carries aggregateFirstNotice=true and nonAdjudicatingNotice=true: it states public facts and computed concentration, it does not rule on legality (G3/G4).

reportCid.description: KotobaCid of the framed markdown report block

aggregateFirstNotice.description: MUST be true (kabuto G3): findings are aggregate-first, not individual-targeting.

nonAdjudicatingNotice.description: MUST be true (kabuto G4): a factual concentration map, NOT a legal verdict.
